review.comments: Reviewed the Philippines DENR-EMB AQI conformance package, including the independent derivations, implementation observations, discrepancy results, regulatory boundary cases, completeness rules, unit handling, Manila-time semantics, and documented methodology limitations. I approve the candidate expectations for immutable promotion. The implementation correctly remains pollutant-specific with no overall/site AQI, preserves decimal interpolation, explicitly represents published gaps and undefined ranges, and keeps deferred features outside this release.
